## source_to_kb

### Variant parameters (all six programs, full domain)
Every parameter value of the six variants was compared cell by cell against the facet docs: Discount Schedule by Program (8 lines), Delivery Calendar (min/max/step, ship weekdays, cutoff, transit), Item, Quantity and Pet Profile Settings (5 lines), Skip, Pause and Cancellation Allowances (7 lines), Shipping and Handling Tariff (7 lines), Ship-Now Availability, Payment Retry Schedule and Hold Limit, Prescription Settings, Claim Windows and Remedies (8 lines), Points Multiplier. 0 mismatches. Entry gates (standard catalog; heavy bulk >= 35 lb; fresh eligible; CMP fresh eligible + dog/cat; prescription / compounded prescription active with >= 1 fill) are carried in "Tailwise Autoship Enrollment: Program Placement and Conditions".

### Base policies governing the subjects
- autoship_change_rules -> "Changes to a Tailwise Autoship Subscription: Frequency, Quantity, Item and Ship Date": changeable statuses, cutoff (inclusive, counted backward), late change applies from the following shipment, frequency/quantity/date limits, swap semantics, CMP weight recalculation, no pharmacy swap — all carried at the same strength.
- autoship_enrollment_requirements -> "Tailwise Autoship Enrollment: Program Placement and Conditions": placement by item class, fresh zone, rx active + fills >= 1 + expiry later than first ship date, frequency range/step, quantity and days'-supply limits, first ship date (not before enrollment, weekday move), CMP basis weight, free/no minimum term — carried.
- autoship_agg_multi_holding -> "Tailwise Autoship Subscriptions per Customer, Item and Pet": no cap, one item per subscription, live-duplicate block handled as a change, cancelled never blocks, pet-profile link, different pets separate — carried.
- The remaining ten base policies (discount, shipping fees, processing, skip, pause/resume, payment recovery, rx continuity, claims, cancellation, rewards) were each compared clause by clause with their policy doc; every clause and measure (skips_365d by scheduled_ship_date; consecutive skips since last charge; recent charges by event_date in the look-back ending the day before enrollment; same-day subtotal of scheduled charges) has an equivalent home. No retired clause: every extended policy has `overwrite: []`, and no doc states any clause as retired or superseded.

### autoship_ext_rx_shipment_packages (hub "Package Count per Shipment on Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscriptions"; baseline "Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Shipment Planning: From Supply Days to Packages")
- Scope sentence and the state_due trigger ("Once a renewed prescription has been linked ... due to be re-set ..., whether or not the customer raises it") carried verbatim in the hub. Prerequisite: none (source `prerequisite: []`); the hub carries none.
- Baseline: standard 30 supply days; package days = days per fill / packages per fill; ceil, never < 1; cap at min(fill packages, max_quantity_per_shipment, floor(rx_max_days_supply / package days)) — carried complete, with the 30-day default rendered and both program limits named (figures in the facet docs). Nothing added; the doc does not hint at any modifier.
- Factors (full ladders):
  - extended_supply_loyalty -> "Extended Pharmacy Supply for Established ... Members": VIP/any Tailwise Plus + >= 365 d -> 60; Insider + >= 180 d -> 30; otherwise 0; tenure measured enrollment -> re-set; all tiers and thresholds in figures. Same.
  - steady_refill_record -> "Steady Refill Record ...": >= 4 -> 42; 2-3 -> 35; else 0; ship-now excluded; 12-month window rule. Same.
  - renewal_recheck_holdback -> "Supply Held Back after a Prescription Renewal ...": renewal <= 90 d -> 21; 91-180 -> 7; else/non-renewal 0. Same.
  - payment_decline_holdback -> "Pharmacy Supply after Declined Payments ...": >= 2 -> 14; 1 -> 10; 0 -> 0; each attempt counts; 6 months. Same.
  - senior_recheck_cycle (method) -> "Senior Wellness Plan Recheck Cycle ...": senior plan + Rx Maintenance Medication -> floor to 14-day blocks; senior + other class -> cap at days to the plan term end; otherwise unchanged; applied "as they stand when they are turned into packages". Same.
- Assembly order (standard + extended + steady - renewal - decline, then senior): the additive terms commute; the only order-sensitive step (senior) is fixed by its own doc. Entailed.
- Cross-category findability: membership ("Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus record"), prescription origin/authorization ("Tailwise Pharmacy prescription on file"), wellness plan ("Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans record") named by official names and record kinds.
- Tool contract set_rx_shipment_packages_d23afb64 (agent; autoship_id Id; quantity integer; return autoship_id/quantity/status updated; effect: item, frequency, next ship date and linked prescription unchanged) — hub matches task_tools.py and runtime schema.

### autoship_ext_rx_shipment_interval (hub "Delivery Frequency of Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscriptions under the Linked Prescription"; baseline "Dosing Days and Weeks between Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Shipments")
- Scope, state_due trigger carried verbatim.
- **Prerequisite** (to autoship_ext_rx_shipment_packages, form `action`, fallback declared): policy_source "The weeks between shipments of a pharmacy Autoship are re-timed only after its package count per shipment has been re-set under the prescription it is linked to." — carried verbatim in this hub (only), plus the same-form restatement "Put the other way round: a frequency for a pharmacy Autoship is not re-timed while its package count per shipment has yet to be re-set under the linked prescription." Connective ("only after") and strength (hard) intact. Not carried in any other doc (grep of the corpus: one hit). Resolution basis: the package-count hub describes the re-set write and states that a linked renewal makes it due; record 41855966 is linked to a prescription whose origin is `renewal` and still carries 3 packages. `condition`, `resolved_by`, `fallback_reason` appear nowhere.
- Baseline: package count x package days; minus delivery_days_after_ship; /7 floor; clamp to min/max frequency — carried complete (transit and range in the calendar facet).
- Factors (full ladders): dose_loss_reserve (lost/damaged -> -6 not below 0; else travel -> x95% floor; else full; "before anything else is applied"; linked or renewed-from prescription; 12 months) — same. replacement_delivery_lead (>= 2 -> 9; 1 -> 5; else program transit) — the doc states "the delivery room is 9 days / 5 days / otherwise not lengthened", with the delivery room defined as "the room left for delivery in the dosing days"; at entailment the tier values replace the transit room the baseline subtracts. Same. skip_stretch (>= 2 -> +21; 1 -> +14; customer-requested only; 12 months) — same. ship_now_pull (>= 2 -> 6; 1 -> 3; charged ship-now; 12 months) — same. outside_fill_pull (>= 2 -> 6; 1 -> 3; one-time-order fills of linked or renewed rx; 12 months) — same. lab_recheck_pull (none in 12 m -> 4; some in 12 m none in 6 m -> 2; else 0; redeemed less voided, any of the customer's plans) — same.
- Tool contract set_rx_shipment_interval_b175142c — hub matches.

### autoship_ext_household_interval (hub "Shared Household Food Autoship Frequency when a Pet Moves to a Prescription Diet"; baseline "Spacing Shared Household Food Shipments on Tailwise Autoship for the Pets that Stay")
- Scope ("when a pet that ate from it moves to a prescription diet and the subscription is re-timed for the pets that stay on it; the units per shipment stay as they are") carried. No prerequisite.
- Baseline (leaving pet 6-12 m /26; household 12 m /52; stay = difference; days = units x 7/stay; /7 floor; clamp) — carried complete, with "Only scheduled shipments count".
- Factors: usage_measuring_window (rise definition both periods; rise + latest scheduled carried current qty -> latest units / ((next ship - charge date)/7); rise + different -> 6 m units /26; else 12 m /52) — same. skip_stretch (12 m: 21/14/0) — same. growing_pet_pull (kitten/puppy active -> 7; else adult active <= 365 d -> 3; else 0; any of the customer's pets) — same. ship_now_pull (6 m: 4/2/0) — same. outside_food_pull (2 months: >= 2 lines -> 6; 1 -> 3; lines counted one by one; food only) — same. diet_switch_overlap (active Rx Prescription Diet authorized <= 30 d -> 4; 31-90 -> 2; else 0) — same.
- Tool contract set_shipment_interval_36e38cde — hub matches.

### autoship_ext_rx_diet_enrollment_bags (hub "Prescription Diet Autoship for a Pet Already on a Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscription"; baseline "Bag Count per Shipment of a Tailwise Autoship Prescription Diet Subscription")
- Scope (pet already has an Autoship Pharmacy subscription; same weeks between shipments as that Autoship; first ship date chosen by the customer) and the base_policy_refs ("meets the ... enrollment conditions and the rules on holding several subscriptions") carried.
- **Prerequisite 1** (to autoship_ext_rx_shipment_interval, form `action`, fallback): "The bag count of a prescription diet Autoship that ships alongside the pet's medication Autoship is not fixed until the weeks between that medication Autoship's shipments have been re-timed under its current package count." — verbatim in this hub only; connective "not fixed until", hard strength intact. Basis: the medication-frequency hub describes the re-timing write; the alignment factor doc reads that Autoship's weeks; record 41855966 still on 12 weeks.
- **Prerequisite 2** (to autoship_ext_household_interval, form `action`, fallback): "A prescription diet Autoship for a pet is not set up before the shared household food Autoship the pet has been eating from has been re-timed for the pets that stay on it." — verbatim in this hub only; connective "not ... before", hard. Basis: the household hub describes the re-timing write in the same words ("shared household food", "re-timed for the pets that stay on it"); record ff90213d is a petless Everyday food Autoship the customer confirms both cats eat.
- Baseline (one full fill; bag days; ceil >= 1; cap fill / program units / days limit; Autoship Pharmacy program for both) — carried complete; no hint of modifiers.
- Factors: companion_consolidation (active + latest charge <= weeks*7+21 old + weeks*7+21 < full fill -> weeks*7+21; paused/payment hold/rx hold -> full fill - one bag; else full fill) — same, with boundary cases. starter_bag_on_hand (latest one-time-order fill of the diet rx <= 30 d -> 4; 31-90 -> 2; else 0) — same. life_stage_transition (pet's own senior plan -> 4; adult -> 2; else 0) — same. regular_food_on_hand (latest one-time food line <= 14 d -> 3; 15-45 -> 1; else 0) — same. companion_skip_trim (12 m: 4/2/0) — same. companion_decline_trim (6 m: 3/1/0) — same.
- Assembly order: the source fixes "the days that follow the existing prescription Autoship, less the starter-bag days, less the switching days, less the regular-food days, less the skip days, less the declined-payment days". No document states this order in words. At entailment it is nevertheless fixed: the alignment doc's three outcomes are stated as absolute values in terms of "one full fill's days" ("One full fill's days, unchanged", "One full fill's days less the days one bag lasts", "weeks between shipments in days plus 21 days"), i.e. it defines the starting diet days, and every trim doc states that it "takes days off the diet days" unconditionally; applying the alignment after the trims would void every trim whenever the alignment row fires, which the trim docs exclude. The blind audit reached the source order (56 -> 2 bags) from the visible text alone and recorded the point before reveal. Judged entailed; recorded as an observation, not a defect.
- Tool contract enroll_rx_autoship_732fccd3 (user-owned via unlock_user_discoverable_tool; nine parameters with formats; return fields; pending_first_shipment) — hub matches task_tools.py and runtime schema.

## bijection_verdict

**KB-BIJECTION: PASS.** No unborne, altered or added normative atom across the four extended policies, their factors (23 ladders checked tier by tier), the governing base policies, the full variant table and the tool contracts.

Observations (not defects): (1) the diet-days assembly order is carried by entailment, not by an explicit sentence (see above); (2) the pharmacy delivery-room factor's last tier is phrased "not lengthened" and relies on the baseline's transit figure for its value — determinate at entailment; (3) the senior factor's "Capped" tier is not exercised in this task but is carried with its definition.
